'''Looting''' is an [[enchantment]] that increases mob drops. [[Matcha Flavoured]] also allows it on shears, where it increases the wool and other items gained by shearing.

== Obtaining ==
* The [[Prayer of Midas]], a crafted [[blessing]], stores Looting III with Fortune I.
* The [[Cleaver]] sold by the [[Cook]] has Looting II.
* Random enchanted books in chests and fishing treasure.

== Behavior ==
Looting's supported items are changed from vanilla's swords and spears to the pack's <code>#minecraft:enchantable/looting_compatible</code> tag, which adds shears.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/enchantment/looting.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/item/enchantable/looting_compatible.json}}</ref> All of the pack's shears (Iron, Copper and the others) are shears items and can take it.

The pack's shearing loot tables for sheep, mooshrooms and bogged use Looting: each item dropped from shearing a sheep gets 0 to 3 extra wool per level of Looting on the shears.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/shearing/sheep/white.json}}</ref>

Many of the pack's mob loot tables use Looting, including the drops of [[Raw Estus]], [[Stable Void]]s and [[Divine Fragment]]s.

Its anvil cost multiplier is 1, down from 4.
